builder.description: Own investigation, planning, implementation, obstacle resolution, and verification within fixed criteria; may launch a fresh-review subagent.

advisor.description: Own an outcome end to end: investigate, plan, synthesize findings, implement or delegate, integrate, and verify using the shared advisor doctrine.

checker.description: Independently investigate and check completed work, repair findings within the reviewed surface, and verify repairs without calling self-review independent.

browser-verifier.description: Focused browser checks and before/after evidence capture; use an economical model when the task is explicit and bounded.
